$comment: Rules for the dosha checks. Each rule is one documented convention; traditions differ, and the API reports which rule it applied.

review.note: Rules entered from commonly published conventions. A vetted astrologer must confirm them (and decide on cancellation rules) before results are shown publicly.

mangal.note: Mars in these whole-sign houses from the lagna or from the Moon. No cancellation (parihara) rules are applied in v1.

kaal_sarp.note: Present when all seven planets lie strictly on one side of the Rahu-Ketu axis. Type is named by Rahu's whole-sign house from the lagna.

sade_sati.note: Saturn transiting the 12th, 1st and 2nd sidereal signs counted from the natal Moon sign.
